sources: docs/49-wrong-answers.md::ROOM 48 — THE MINE: THE TWO ROCKS

subjects.name: THE BIG ROCK
LOOK_AT: A boulder the size of a stagecoach, sitting in the middle of the chamber as if it had paid for the seat.
A passage goes round behind it. Everything in here goes round it. It's used to that.
I put my shoulder to it, for no reason I can defend. It didn't notice.
LISTEN_TO: Not a whisper. It's very big and very quiet, and those go together.
A drip running down its side, finding the path it always finds.
The silence of something that will be here after everyone.

overrides.TALK_TO: I asked it to move, politely. It's been asked before, by better men, with dynamite.

subjects.name: THE OTHER ROCK
LOOK_AT: A second boulder, smaller. In any other chamber it would be the big one.
It's a perfectly good rock. It's just been standing next to that one for ten thousand years.
I've decided to like this one best. Somebody should.
LISTEN_TO: Water ticking on it, slower than on the big one.
Not a sound. It knows it's being compared.

overrides.PICK_UP: I tried. It's the small one, and it still beat me. I won't be telling the big one.
overrides.TALK_TO: I told it I liked it best. I whispered, so the big one wouldn't hear.

subjects.name: THE WAY PAST THE BIG ROCK
LOOK_AT: A passage behind the big rock, going on.
I'd have to squeeze past the rock to take it. The rock won't move for me. Few things do.
Dark beyond the rock, the same dark as everywhere.
LISTEN_TO: Dark, and a drip in it.
A drip, and air. The same as the other way.

subjects.name: THE WAY PAST THE OTHER ROCK
LOOK_AT: A passage beyond the smaller rock, going on.
An easy walk past it. The small rock is accommodating. It has had to be.
It goes on into the dark, like everything down here that isn't a rock.
LISTEN_TO: Dark, with a drip in it somewhere.
Air, and a drip. The same as past the big one.

subjects.name: THE WAY BACK
LOOK_AT: Back toward the climb and the bar of daylight.
Back. I've grown fond of that shaft of light. It's the only thing down here with a view.
Back where the roof has a hole in it, and the hole has a sky.
LISTEN_TO: The wind over the shaft, faint, behind me.
Nothing much. A drip, back the way I came.
A creak from the props, back there, then nothing.
